answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 33242 Country: India Title: I gave three talaqs to my first wife on the same day and same time. Question: I gave three talaqs to my first wife on the same day and same time. I have a daughter with her and after two years, she wants to come back. Please let me know how can I bring her back as I am confuse with different opinions from different people and I do not want to commit a sin. Is there any way to bring her back? Answer ID: 33242 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1419/864/H=1432) You can take her back through legal halalah. There is no other way for her to be halal. It is mentioned in Bukhari Vol. 2, p. 791 and Fatawa Hindiyah, Vol. 1, p. 501. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
